Method: manual API chain (same #366-workaround family as the Qwen3-0.6B entry) - source uploads mqkkv033z/mq8kd5e2j/mqy3vr60v, 6 graph compiles (jg9qxxnwp, j5wr116mp, jg9qxx08p, jpyy77zlp, jgz044v45, jpr7nnovg), link jpvn9997g -> context binary mqkkv012k, per-graph profiles: prefill 125,020 us/128 tok = 384 + 46,614 + 78,022 (jobs jgz044l65, jp8k413qp, jp1mv6vkp); decode 61,063 us/tok = 155 + 20,679 + 40,229 (jobs jgkk9912g, j5mld84yg, jpvn9777g). Graph-profile derived, not a Genie end-to-end run; w4a16, context 512. First public QCS6490 measurement for this model. Unlike Qwen3, the Llama family ships no pre-quantized zip: official encodings + local ONNX export split into 3 parts from FP weights (export path requires torch<2.11, pinned per model requirements). FP weights bit-identical to the gated meta-llama repo (model.safetensors sha256 1ff795ff6a07e6a68085d206fb84417da2f083f68391c2843cd2b8ac6df8538f), sourced via the unsloth mirror because the hub account is not on the gated repo's authorized list.

cells.notes: MEASURED 2026-11-16 on real RB3 Gen 2 silicon, per-graph AI Hub profiles (estimated_inference_time), w4a16, context 512, manual API chain. Text backbone = 4 parts x 2 graphs. Prompt ar128 (us per 128 tok): part2 68,980 (job jp42392vg), part3 69,011 (jp1m66z8p), part4 36,122 (jgj8qql15). Decode ar1 (us per tok): part2 20,224 (jp423ymqg), part3 20,300 (jp3r6z6xp), part4 22,291 (jp0x6ov0p). PART 1 (layers 0-8) AND THE VISION ENCODER COULD NOT BE PROFILED: all 9 compiles succeed, but on-device QnnModel_composeGraphsFromDlc fails with MODEL_GRAPH_ERROR for part1 both graphs (5 attempts) and the vision encoder (3 attempts); linking the text graphs fails naming FP32 tensor '/model/model/layers.2/mlp/down_proj/Conv_bias' as not supported by the targeted device. Recompiling part1 with -O1 instead of -O0 (job jp1m6kvnp) does not change the compose failure - defect localized to the vendor AOT asset (fp16mix), not the compile options. Full-model prefill/decode therefore UNKNOWN; measured parts 2-4 alone sum to prompt 174,113 us and decode 62,815 us/tok. First public QCS6490 attempt for this VLM.
